title: FOC planned opposition march for 21 March 2023, postponed in advance
reason: Journal Le Pays reports on 20 March that FOC postponed the planned 21 March march to a later date before the event; this is an announcement and postponement, not an established March gathering.
notes: Announced demands were dissolution of CONOREC and release of political/opinion prisoners. The report does not exclude a substitute unreported gathering.
open_questions: Did FOC or another group hold a substitute public gathering on 21 March?
